articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that collapses previously separate models into one system. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex agentic coding tasks, raising the bar for frontier AI capabilities.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini 2.5 Ultra with Million-Token Persistent Memory
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which pairs its extended 2-million-token context window with a persistent memory layer that allows it to recall user-specific context across sessions. The feature is aimed at enterprise agentic workflows and long-running research assistants, marking a shift toward stateful AI systems.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Plant
articles.summary: Figure AI started deploying its Figure 02 humanoid robots on a BMW assembly line in Spartanburg, South Carolina, handling parts transfer, inspection, and light assembly tasks. The robots operate alongside human workers with real-time vision-language model reasoning for task adaptation, representing one of the first sustained commercial humanoid deployments in automotive manufacturing.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Demonstrates Autonomous Disaster Response in DARPA Field Trial
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics showcased its electric Atlas humanoid navigating a collapsed building scenario in a DARPA-organized field trial, autonomously mapping debris fields, opening doors, and retrieving simulated casualties. The system used on-board LiDAR fused with a vision-language planner, achieving task completion rates above 80% without human teleoperation.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration for Multi-Agent Enterprise Pipelines
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new orchestration framework allowing Claude models to coordinate as specialized agents in multi-step enterprise workflows, with built-in sandboxing, audit trails, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Early adopters report 40-60% reductions in back-office processing time for legal document review and financial compliance tasks.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm GAA Chips, Powering Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production at its Fab 20 in Hsinchu using its N2 gate-all-around transistor process, with Apple and NVIDIA among the first customers. The node delivers roughly 25% better performance at the same power compared to 3nm, a critical enabler for next-generation AI training and inference hardware.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance to Expand Brain-Computer Interface Trial to 50 Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to expand its PRIME study to 50 participants with spinal cord injuries and ALS, following positive 18-month safety and efficacy data from its initial cohort. Patients demonstrated reliable cursor control and text input speeds exceeding 30 words per minute, accelerating the path toward broader clinical availability.

articles.title: Toyota Research Institute Demos Diffusion-Policy Robot That Learns Household Tasks from 10 Minutes of Video
articles.summary: TRI demonstrated a manipulation system that uses video diffusion policies to learn dexterous household tasks—such as folding laundry and loading dishwashers—from as few as 10 minutes of human demonstration video. The approach generalizes across object shapes and kitchen layouts, significantly reducing the data and engineering overhead of traditional robot learning pipelines.
